يشلان (form I)

# يَشُلَّانِ (yašullāni) /ja.ʃul.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# يُشَلَّانِ (yušallāni) /ju.ʃal.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
